task.title: Restore the people directory and assignment from the queue
task.description:
Workbench built a people directory from commit history across the imported projects, let the user merge identities and name them, and assigned tasks from the queue table. The move left it out; this task brings it back once the queue is back.

The removal is a single commit on the move's branch, named in that pull request. It covered: `src/main/people.js`, the `view-people` section, the assign menu, the five `people:*` channels, `task:assign` and `task:unassign`, the `defaultAssignee` and `people` registry fields, and `assign`, `unassign` and `EXIT_ASSIGNED` in `workbook.js`. Workbench's cache of the directory (keyed on the project set plus the identity mapping, so only import, forget, merge or rename rebuilt it) is worth keeping when it returns.

Depends on the queue.
